name: Omni Fort Lauderdale Hotel
positioning: Waterfront hotel on the Intracoastal Waterway in Fort Lauderdale's Marina District, connected to the Broward County Convention Center and steps from Port Everglades
best_for: Cruise travelers wanting a pre- or post-cruise stay steps from Port Everglades
Convention attendees at the Broward County Convention Center
Spa-goers who want Hammam rituals and an open-air plunge pool

facts.text: The hotel sits along the Intracoastal Waterway and is directly connected to the Broward County Convention Center.
The hotel is in Fort Lauderdale's Marina District.
The hotel is steps from Port Everglades and suited to pre- and post-cruise stays.
Mokara Spa is a wellness retreat inspired by Florida's natural springs.
The swimming pool is on the 10th floor and is open year-round to all hotel guests.
Premier rooms are on the top floors, with coastal views and a spacious sitting area.
Deluxe rooms have a modern design with floor-to-ceiling windows.
Fair Ketch is a sports and entertainment bar with a two-bay Topgolf Swing Suite.
Reef 76: Kitchen & Bar serves fresh seafood and coastal dishes.
The hotel is about 3.4 miles from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport.

highlights.text: Mokara Spa offers massages, facials, signature Hammam rituals, sauna, steam and an open-air courtyard plunge pool.
Guests see passing yachts and canals, and from higher floors the Atlantic Ocean.
The pool deck has Intracoastal views, loungers and private cabanas.
Ibis Sky Lounge is a rooftop bar with panoramic views from the 29th floor.
Cruise guests get complimentary luggage storage and shuttle service to the port.

considerations.text: The hotel is near Fort Lauderdale Beach, not on it.
WhataHotel notes that, as a convention center hotel, public spaces can be busier during large events.
Guests must be 18 or older to check in.
